series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits high unpredictability (spectral entropy >0.85) and concept drift, indicating unstable patterns. A robust baseline strategy (e.g., median) is recommended to handle the high variability and avoid overfitting to transient model performance.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true AND spectral_entropy=0.9317 → robust_median is recommended for high-noise, near-white-noise series (Goerg 2013)
reasoning.trimmed_mean_r0.20: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true AND model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=2.7485 → trimmed mean with 20% trimming mitigates outlier models (Genre et al. 2013)
reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.3_trim0.6: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → ADE dynamic error weighting adapts to changing model performance (Cerqueira et al. 2019)
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=2.7485 AND recommended_knobs.top_k=4 AND shrinkage=0.35 → inverse RMSE weights with regularization exploit performance differences while avoiding overfitting

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid=ridge_stacking AND n_windows=2 → ridge stacking overfits with few validation windows
